title: Mai Raahe Shaam se
body:
mai raah-e-shaam se guzri hoo berida baba
aseere zulm hoo roti hoo berida baba
<<DIVIDER>>
tha be-kafan tera islam mai rida dekar
bala ke dasht se aayi hoo berida baba
mai raah-e-shaam se…
<<DIVIDER>>
sitamgaron ne jagaya hai taaziyano se
jo thak ke raah mein soti hoo berida baba
mai raah-e-shaam se…
<<DIVIDER>>
adoo jo durre lagate hai mere abid ko
mai dil ko thaam ke roti hoo berida baba
mai raah-e-shaam se…
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo bahaata hai ankhon se abid-e-muztar
mai jab bhi kanton pe chalti hoo berida baba
mai raah-e-shaam se…
<<DIVIDER>>
safar ki khaakh ne baalon ka karliya parda
mai iske baad bhi phirti hoo berida baba
mai raah-e-shaam se…
<<DIVIDER>>
bichadne waalon ke matam mein raat din guzre
har ek naam pe tadpi hoo berida baba
mai raah-e-shaam se…
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aseeri pe mazhar ne jo likha nauha
har ek lafz pe tadpi hoo berida baba
mai raah-e-shaam se…
author: Mazhar
